info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Lawsonit Pendant Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Lawsonit Pendant Detail Management API allows users to create detailed entries for Lawsonit pendants in the product catalog. This API facilitates the onboarding of new pendant designs, ensuring accurate and comprehensive product specifications are available. Typical consumers include product managers and e-commerce operators aiming to enhance their catalog with rich product data. With this API, businesses can streamline their inventory management and improve customer engagement by providing detailed pendant information.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create new details for LawsonIT pendants. Ensure you provide all necessary information in the request body to successfully create the pendant details.

requestBody.description: Request body containing the details for the LawsonIT pendant operation. It should include all necessary fields required to process the request, ensuring all values are correctly formatted as per the specified schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested details.

CreateCatalogLawsonitPendantDetailReques.title: LawsonIT Pendant Details Request

lawsonit_pendant_id.description: The unique identifier for the LawsonIT pendant.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the pendant.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the pendant.

CreateCatalogLawsonitPendantDetailReques.description: Schema representing the request body for creating or updating LawsonIT pendant details.

height.description: The height of the pendant in specified units.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the dimensions (e.g., cm, inches).
